root_cause: Composio connection metadata reported LinkedIn accounts ACTIVE while a real LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO provider call returned 401 REVOKED_ACCESS_TOKEN.

LinkedIn publication claimed the daily row and progressed publication authority before real provider authentication was proven, allowing an authentication failure to leave the daily claim blocked instead of resumable.
Buffer was hard rate-limited and therefore cannot be a critical dependency for LinkedIn or Instagram delivery.
The deployed Instagram media router enforced temporal Reel proof that was missing from repository main, creating runtime/source contract drift.
prevention: Run a real LinkedIn provider read before claim, publication capability consumption, uniqueness reservation or provider side effects.
Treat revoked/expired/401/403 LinkedIn authentication as resumable provider state while no provider side effect exists; keep the same daily claim content_ready and never create a replacement claim.
An existing LinkedIn provider URN remains republish-forbidden and is reconciled only by exact URN.
Buffer is telemetry/fallback only and never gates direct LinkedIn or canonical Instagram delivery.

Repository source and deployed Instagram router must share the same continuous-video proof contract; Reel publication requires temporal continuity evidence in addition to start/middle/end frame proof.
The social watchdog performs repeated provider-auth and final-provider-readback checks during the Amsterdam delivery day.

evidence.linkedin: All three pre-existing LinkedIn connections returned 401 REVOKED_ACCESS_TOKEN on real provider read
evidence.instagram: Instagram Business provider read and quota endpoint succeeded; quota usage 0/100
